name: Hartford
why: Alternative Classics — a Frenchman's 1960s America in Albini and Maruwa cloth; chambray shirts with Hawaiian-dancer embroidery, beloved of Springsteen and Clapton.
origin: Yves Chareton, 1979 — a New York manufacturer sold him deadstock Oxford and chambray; the shirts came first, the studio moved home to Paris, and his children Marina and Yann now run women's and e-commerce.
opview: “Alternative Classics” — the house's own formula: classic cloth and cuts, humor in the details.

onething.n: the founding object — deadstock chambray started the brand; verify link

notes.fren: a Frenchman selling America back to both continents — the Palm Angels pattern, a generation early
notes.cotton: founded on deadstock oxford and chambray — Albini and Maruwa on the labels
notes.craft: mills named: Albini, Maruwa, Liberty, French linen

cities: Paris showroom · US specialty & dept stores
